test_title: PYST 20: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - Quant (Held On 10 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: 14 men complete a work in 10 days. If 7 men are employed, then in how many days will they complete the same work?
solution:
**Formula:**

Total work = Total men working × Total time required 

**Calculation:**

Total work = 14 × 10 = 140 men-days

Time required by 7 men to complete the work = 140over 7 = 20 days

∴ **Total time required by 7 men is 20 days.**
